  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "HR Generalist",
  "description": "Ikeja Electric is one of the largest power distribution companies in Nigeria, committed to delivering reliable and efficient electricity services to our customers. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainability, we aim to transform the energy landscape in Nigeria and contribute to the country&#39;s economic development. Our mission is to provide exceptional service while ensuring the safety and well-being of our employees and customers. At Ikeja Electric, we don&rsquo;t just power homes and businesses &ndash; we power careers. As a leading energy provider, we are committed to fostering a culture that champions integrity, innovation, and excellence. Our team is the heartbeat of our success, and we thrive on collaboration, continuous improvement, and creating a workplace where everyone can shine.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR Generalist
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	This opportunity is a Middle-Level Management role.
	Your role will directly support strategic HR delivery, workforce effectiveness, employee engagement, and organizational performance.
	This role directly reports to the HR Business Partner (HRBP).
	As HR Generalist, you will provide comprehensive HR support to align people strategies with business objectives.
	You will partner with business leaders to strengthen talent management, employee engagement, performance, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.


You&rsquo;ll contribute to


	Partner with business leaders to align HR solutions with business goals.
	Identify workforce gaps and support talent development and succession planning.
	Coordinate performance management and employee engagement initiatives.
	Provide guidance on employee relations and conflict resolution.
	Support workforce planning and high performance team development.
	Ensure compliance with HR policies, labour laws, and ethical standards.
	Use workforce data to inform HR decisions and process improvements.
	Perform other duties assigned by the HR Business Partner.


This position offers an incredible opportunity to:


	Develop strategic HR business partnering capabilities.
	Strengthen expertise in talent management and workforce planning.
	Enhance employee relations, performance management, and engagement skills.
	Build business acumen and data driven decision-making capabilities.
	Develop the skills required for future HR leadership opportunities.


Minimum Requirement
Education:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Human Resources Management, Industrial Relations, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
	CIPM Associate or Chartered certification is required.
	Candidates should demonstrate strong knowledge of recruitment practices, labour laws, and HR policies, alongside excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills


Work Experience:


	A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in HR generalist, employee experience, employee development, or people operations roles.


Skills &amp; Competencies:


	The role affords you to develop technical and behavioral competencies, that is, skills, knowledge, and behaviors required to successfully perform in the role and contribute to the organization&#39;s goals.


Technical Competencies:


	Business acumen and strategic HR insight.
	Talent development and succession planning.
	Data analysis and evidence-based decision-making.
	Employee relations, conflict resolution, and mediation.
	Knowledge of recruitment practices, labour laws, and HR policies.
	Stakeholder management and communication skills.


Behavioral Competencies:


	Customer Centricity: Delivers practical HR solutions that improve employee experience, performance, and business outcomes.
	Risk Management: Ensures compliance with HR policies, labour laws, and ethical standards while proactively addressing people-related risks.
	People Leadership: Coaches and influences managers to build high performing teams and promote accountability.
	Entrepreneurship: Develops innovative HR solutions that address workforce challenges and support business objectives.
	Organizational Learning: Uses workforce data and employee feedback to improve talent development and HR practices.
	Change Management: Supports organizational change through effective communication and alignment of HR initiatives with business priorities.

Portfolio Manager Job at Ploutos Asset Management




        
    

        
        Ploutos Financials is a financial services company, under Metro Group providing accessible lending and financing solutions to individuals and businesses. The company offers personal and business loans alongside tailored financial services designed to support business growth, improve financial inclusion, and help clients achieve their financial goals through responsible lending.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Portfolio Manager

Job Location: Oniru, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The successful candidate will support the Managing Director/chief executive officer in developing and implementing investment strategies, managing client portfolios, conducting investment research and analysis, monitoring portfolio performance, and ensuring effective risk management and regulatory compliance across relevant asset classes.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement investment strategies aligned with clients’ investment objectives and the firm’s business goals.
	Conduct financial modelling, company valuation, market research and investment analysis to support sound investment decisions.
	Manage and monitor investment portfolios, assess performance against benchmarks, and recommend appropriate portfolio rebalancing.
	Identify, evaluate and manage investment risks while ensuring compliance with applicable SEC regulations and internal investment policies.
	Prepare investment proposals, portfolio performance reports, market outlooks and periodic reports for management and clients.
	Monitor developments in the capital market, money market, fixed income, equities and other relevant investment asset classes.
	Support product development, business growth, client relationship management and the mobilisation of investment funds.
	Maintain proper investment documentation, internal controls and adherence to the firm’s governance and risk management frameworks.


Qualifications and Experience
Applicants must meet the following requirements.


	Interested candidates should possess a Master's Degree
	Must be eligible and qualified to serve as an SEC-sponsored individual in the relevant fund and portfolio management function.
	Minimum of 10 years’ relevant experience in asset management, portfolio management, investment banking, corporate finance, banking or a related financial services field.
	Strong knowledge of corporate finance, financial modelling, valuation techniques, investment research and portfolio construction.
	Demonstrable experience in investment decision-making, portfolio monitoring, performance measurement and risk management.
	Sound understanding of Nigeria’s capital market, applicable SEC regulations and investment management practices.
	Strong analytical, leadership, communication and report-writing skills.
	Relevant professional qualifications, such as CFA, CIS or other recognised finance and investment credentials, will be an added advantage.


Why Join Ploutos Asset Management Ltd?


	This is an opportunity to contribute to the growth of a dynamic asset management firm, influence investment strategy, deliver value to clients and participate in building a strong, performance-driven investment management business.


Remuneration
Very attractive and competitive

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using “Application for Portfolio Manager” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Application Developer Job at the International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA)




        
    

        
        The International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA) is a not-for-profit institution that generates agricultural innovations to meet Africa’s most pressing challenges of hunger, malnutrition, poverty, and natural resource degradation. Working with various partners across sub-Saharan Africa, we improve livelihoods, enhance food and nutrition security, increase employment, and preserve natural resource integrity. IITA is a member of CGIAR, a global agriculture research partnership for a food secure future.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Application Developer

Job ID: STS2026-13
Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo

Duties
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Design, develop, and implement new features and enhancements for the RFU application using C# and .NET Framework.
	Thoroughly test new features and enhancements to ensure quality and functionality before deployment.
	Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues to ensure system stability and performance.
	Develop and maintain relevant technical and user documentation for the application.
	Train and support users to ensure effective and optimal use of the application.
	Serve as the first point of contact for RFU users and provide timely resolution of application-related issues.
	Apply software development, security, coding, and version control best practices.
	Work with users and teams to gather requirements and support application integration with relevant systems.
	Perform any other duties assigned by the Supervisor.


Requirements


	BSc / HND / B.Tech Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related discipline with a minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience in a well-structured organization.


Competencies
The ideal candidate must have:


	Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Framework, application development, maintenance, and system integration.
	Practical experience in web application development, database design, management, and integration.
	Knowledge of user interface and user experience design principles.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
	Good interpersonal and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with users and technical teams.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.

Job Position: Shipping & Documentation Coordinator
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a Shipping & Documentation Coordinator to manage local and international shipments, prepare and maintain shipping documentation, and ensure compliance with import/export regulations.


Key Responsibilities
